notes: «قالا أخبرنا الليث» is a dual: Yahya and Muhammad both report from Layth; «ح» then the second branch, and «عن نافع، عن عبد الله» is written once after the last «ح», so it is the shared tail
The Prophet's practice is reported by Abdullah's words «ثم قال كان رسول الله»: the Prophet is the end, not a link
